items: Large slots show the whole day; compact slots use a touch-controlled first 12 / next 12 hour view.
Feels-like temperature, precipitation amount, wind speed and direction, and UV appear on touch.
Save up to three locations and tap the location header to switch without digging through settings.
Sunrise, sunset, civil dawn and civil dusk are integrated into the actual forecast ribbon.
